decisions.note: Pinned skill 108901111 is 偉大なる踏破. The Japanese title directly denotes a great/majestic traversal or conquest; 'Cuộc chinh phục vĩ đại' is concise and natural as a Vietnamese skill title.

Pinned skill 1400021 is Japanese レジェンダリーアクセル. The title is a katakana compound and the repository has no reviewed rule deciding whether this specific skill should be romanized as an English-style title or translated; defer.
Pinned skill 410011 is exactly 伝説降臨. 'Huyền thoại giáng lâm' preserves the compact dramatic title without relying on the Chinese bridge for a proper name.
Pinned skill 110351 is Japanese 夢の先へ、届け！. The imperative 届け can be rendered as reach, carry or deliver depending on the intended poetic voice; defer rather than canonize one interpretation.
Pinned skill 203742 is 間隙を突いて, literally exploiting an opening. 'Chớp lấy sơ hở' is a concise natural Vietnamese title matching that action.

decisions.target_vi: Là một thành viên của đội
decisions.note: Pinned skill 300121 is チームの一員として. The Japanese wording is explicit and has a stable direct Vietnamese rendering.

Pinned skill 100702211 is Japanese イカ揚げ、いかがですか！？, which uses a deliberate イカ揚げ/いかが wordplay. The Chinese bridge interprets 揚げ differently, so defer until a Vietnamese pun-preserving treatment is reviewed.

Pinned skill 109601111 is Japanese 侵掠如火, a compact literary four-character phrase. Literal Vietnamese and Sino-Vietnamese renderings differ sharply in register; defer rather than flatten the literary title.
Pinned skill 112401111 is Japanese 俊傑の悠. The title is stylized/literary and 悠 has several plausible nuances; defer canonical Vietnamese wording.

Pinned skill 200562 is スタミナキープ. The Japanese source explicitly uses Stamina, so the locked project distinction requires Thể lực; do not follow the Chinese 体力 bridge into the training-energy term Năng lượng.
Pinned skill 200472 is ペースキープ. 'Giữ nhịp' is the concise natural Vietnamese equivalent of keeping pace.
Pinned skill 201192 is リードキープ. 'Duy trì dẫn đầu' directly preserves the racing sense of keeping one's lead.
Pinned skill 203052 is 揺るがぬ信念. The Vietnamese title directly and naturally preserves the meaning.
Pinned skill 203902 is 急降下. 'Lao xuống' is a compact natural Vietnamese rendering of a sudden dive/descent.
Pinned skill 204002 is 意地っ張り. 'Bướng bỉnh' is the stable colloquial Vietnamese equivalent.
Pinned skill 201702 is ありったけ, meaning to use all one has. 'Dốc hết sức' is concise and natural in a racing skill context.
Pinned skill 110051 uses the Latin-script title Ravissant exactly. Preserve the verified source title rather than translating the Chinese semantic bridge.
Pinned skill 210322 is いつまでも健やかに. 'Mãi khỏe mạnh' is a compact natural Vietnamese rendering of the enduring well-being wish.
Pinned skill 203662 is 健脚, denoting strong/healthy legs. 'Đôi chân khỏe' is direct and readable as a Vietnamese skill title.

Pinned skill 414061 is Japanese 元気特盛りのおもてなし. 特盛り evokes an extra-large serving while modifying hospitality/energy, creating character-flavored wordplay; defer rather than flatten it into a generic translation.
